# Request
/okf:okf produce

# Repository
The work directory holds files from rfrezino/datadog-delphi at commit 3cde15b, from: ..
Edit them in place; you can also create new files inside those paths. When the run succeeds your changes are proposed as a pull request for people to review.
Changes outside those paths are rejected, and so is any change to protected files (the .github directory, CODEOWNERS and similar), which are not provided.
You have no shell and no network: you cannot run tests or builds, only read and edit text files.

I didn't change anything, because I couldn't tell what `/okf:okf produce` is meant to do.

- **No match in the files:** a case-insensitive search of the `rfrezino/datadog-delphi` files (commit 3cde15b) for "okf" found nothing. There is no skill, command definition, config or doc that describes it.
- **Not available to me:** the slash command isn't something I can run here. I have no shell and no plugin that provides it.

To go further I need to know what "produce" should produce. For example, it could be a document, a report, or a code change. It would also help to know which part of the repository it should cover, and whether you want it as a file or as a pull request. If `okf` is a plugin or skill you use elsewhere, paste its instructions into the request and I'll follow them.
